comment: Flange per the BT40 standard (JIS B 6339 / ISO 7388-1, flange 63 mm); the body and nose are a conservative generic envelope for collision checks; nose: ER32 collet nut about 50 mm across (ISO 15488 ER32 collets). Measure your own holders and correct the segments.
name: BT40 ER32 collet chuck, 70 mm gauge
